verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say syncs run on a schedule or trigger you set, with outcome reporting and failure alerts for each run. Its marketing describes syncing to 300+ destinations in real time or on a recurring schedule, and AI Decisioning agents include scheduling rules. The MCP server and REST API can manage syncs, which suits AI-native use, though no item shows them setting schedules. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule options (cron or interval granularity), explicit evidence that schedules can be created or edited via the API or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring scheduling.
